data.query: what are the 2026 F1   engine rules?
data.summary:
The 2026 Formula 1 power unit regulations introduce a 50/50 ICE and electrical split.
- MGU-H is removed to simplify power unit architecture.
- Electrical MGU-K output increases to 350kW.
- Cars run on 100% sustainable synthetic fuel.
findings: MGU-H is removed to simplify power unit architecture.
